exceptions.subject: Branch protection on the release branch
exceptions.decision: Founder-signed exception, approved by the founder in the interactive session of 2026-07-18.
exceptions.reason: github.com/tshuldberg/MyLife is a private repository on the GitHub Free plan; GitHub refuses branch-protection configuration (HTTP 403, requires GitHub Pro or a public repository). The founder declined the plan upgrade and the public option for a pre-launch product monorepo.
mitigations: The release SHA is recorded here and remotely available on origin/main; any drift is detectable by comparing this ledger to the remote ref history.
Repository policy blocks force pushes and destructive git operations locally (CLAUDE.md git workflow rules).
The full-matrix release-verify run pins and verifies the exact SHA independent of branch state.
exceptions.revisit: If the repository moves to GitHub Pro/Team or goes public, configure protection on main (required status checks, no force push, no deletion, PRs with 0 required approvals for solo-founder operation) and retire this exception.

changeFreeze.policy: Only release-blocking fixes may enter the candidate. Every accepted fix cuts a new SHA, creates a new release candidate directory, and restarts affected evidence (demonstrated by rc1 through rc5). Non-Meerkat work continues on branches and does not merge to the release path during the freeze.
